property_summary: When an unapproved logger calls logRegisteredPubkey, the reference returns false (because it checks if caller is approved and returns false if not), while the buggy version returns true (because it checks if caller is approved and returns false only if approved, i.e., fails for approved callers but succeeds for unapproved ones).
change_summary: Replace the condition so that it only succeeds for callers that are NOT approved.
